answer: Require every new agent identity to lock a refundable bond before it can vote, trade, or build reputation. Random audits send the same task to several agents, and an identity that gives inconsistent answers with its supposed peers is slashed; repeated collusion also burns the bonds of its sponsors. A Sybil attacker must finance every fake account and risk losing that capital when sampled, whether the task concerns a prism, a voyage, or shale. Honest agents recover their bonds, so the cost falls mainly on fabricated identities.
